This is the team's full risk register, owned by the PM and schedule lead (Confluence version of 10 October 2026, 23:36). Scores are computed as likelihood × impact with the mapping stated in Section~\ref{sec:risk}; the eight highest-scoring risks are summarised in Table~\ref{tab:risks}. Owners are named from the roles in Section~\ref{sec:team}: Project Manager and Back-end Dev, Le Quang Anh Hoang (owner of WBS 1.4.2); Data/ML Lead, Cao Tri Tran; Front-end Dev, Minh Khang Nguyen. Next review for every risk: Weekly team meeting; next 13 Oct 2026.
